1.crc console \--url  
above command to see the url to login to that host of openshift crc is for local developement not for produciton ready  
for in crc to use oc commands use below command to run  
eval $(crc oc-env)

2.case1: without password in command

oc login \-u developer https://api.lab.example.com:6443

case2: with password in command

oc login \-u developer \-p developer \\  
https://api.lab.example.com:6443

3.oc whoami \--show-console  
for seeing the url 3rd command in oc
